design.rationale: Original cut-paper screening-dossier interpretation of the Blue Note pin from the verified 2026-09-27 saved-pin snapshot; the public board was inaccessible, so this is not a new observation. Indigo paper, warm projector yellow and a restrained brick-red registration edge reorganize the complete deck into torn-ticket navigation, a poster-scale hero, pasted metric slips, staggered study and roadmap sheets, framed resource strips, paired film cards and tactile logbook folios without copying the reference artwork.
